roadmap.goal: ADO Epic 6350 'Every report in one place, created and removed in bulk'. Eight slices, delivered one at a time in this order, each releasable alone: 01 (#6428) a top-level Reports page at /reports listing every report the reader can read across Teams and Portfolios, with its owner, row icons, loading / could-not-load / empty looks and the AllReportsListed usage event; 02a (#6429) Create reports for several Teams in one run through one bulk request, owner by owner, with a per-owner result, the creation-options read, the wizard that waits for what a report needs, the Create button's states and the one E2E walking skeleton; 02b (#6430) the owner step's Admin-only list, its loading and could-not-load looks and the useRbac load-failed flag; 03 (#6431) Portfolios join the same selection with the 30/90/180/custom window presets; 04 (#6432) owners whose kept history cannot hold the windows are listed greyed with the reason and a settings link; 05 (#6433) the selection column turns on and Remove acts on it through one bulk-removal request, Admin per report; 06 (#6434, lighthouse-clients repo) `lh report list` with no owner and the MCP tool `lighthouse_report_list`; 07 (#6435) Export PDF of the selection as one PDF through the hidden print frame. The invariant every step keeps: the per-owner Reports tab, the single wizard, the single PDF export and every per-owner endpoint body stay exactly as they are. Docs prose, screenshots, release notes, mutation runs and releases belong to finalization and are NOT steps here.
